producer_report.summary:
Athena now runs the configured checks (fmt, clippy, test) on the producer's tree before the verifier. A new failure goes into the one existing send-back with its command, exit status and output tail. A failure still there after the send-back reaches the verifier as a flagged `producer-report-gaps` entry.

Root cause: the recorded checks ran only at verification, so the producer could not see a failing gate before the verdict.

- **Code:** `producer_loop` calls `Athena::loop_check_failures` in run/checks.rs. It builds in the producer's own `target/produce` and takes a build slot only if one is free (it never waits). It skips with a visible line for low disk, a busy slot, an error or a change to check-tool configuration, and only the kill switch ends the job from it.
- **Limits:** `PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS` stays 1, with only its comment extended. No loop is added.
- **Departure from criterion 1:** `GIT_INDEX_FILE` is set only for the one `git add -A` that builds the temporary index. That index is swapped into the snapshot's `.git/index` and restored on drop, so `git ls-files` lists producer-added files. It is never exported to the checks, because a shared index would break the git calls inside Athena's own tests. D182 records this.
- **Brief and prompt:** the producer brief gets a "Checks before the verifier" section with a test. producer.md changes net zero and is still 1102 bytes. D182 is appended to docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md has one bullet.
- **Tests:** the new core tests cover the send-back, a failure still there at the limit, a clean first pass, producer-added files, git inside a check, base failures, tool-config skip, low disk, a busy slot and the index guard. `MARKS_BASELINE_OUTSIDE` now touches its mark only in a `*/baseline` directory.
- **athena-cli fix:** I fixed one assertion in retry.rs (`a_failed_check_retries_from_the_base`). The retry's producer run is now `seen[2]` because the first attempt gets a send-back run. The test also asserts that the send-back happened.
- **Checks:** fmt and clippy are clean. The athena-core, athena-context and athena-cli suites pass, and so do the mirrors, budgets and boundary-policy scans. The only other failure was one drain.rs timing flake (see open issues).

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/run/producer.rs runs the configured checks (via the existing runner in crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs) on the producer's tree before the verifier, with GIT_INDEX_FILE set to a temporary index of the work tree. A failure's command, exit status and output tail are added to the existing send-back problems and rendered by send_back_text in crates/athena-core/src/run/send_back.rs. The stored invocation detail names the check failure.
criteria_check.evidence: producer_loop calls Athena::loop_check_failures (run/checks.rs), which runs the routed checks through SnapExec and run_check. A failure adds a problem string (so the stored `self-check failed:` detail names it) and goes into the send-back through append_check_failures in send_back.rs, with command, exit status and output tail. The test a_failing_check_is_sent_back_before_the_verifier_and_the_fix_reaches_it asserts the second brief and the stored detail; cargo test -p athena-core passes. Departure from the literal wording, as the plan decided: GIT_INDEX_FILE is set only for the one `git add -A` in ExposedIndex::new that builds the temporary index (the method of Snapshot::work_tree_tree). That index is installed as the snapshot's .git/index for the run and restored on drop. It is never exported to the checks, because run_check's environment would leak one shared index into the git calls of Athena's own tests. The decision entry D182 records this. The new-file test and the marker's `index=unset` assertion cover it.

criteria_check.criterion: The send-back stays bounded by PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS in crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (diff shows no new loop and no changed limit). A check still failing after the send-back is passed to the verifier as flagged, not hidden.
criteria_check.evidence: The mod.rs diff changes only the PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS doc comment (value stays 1), the import, `in_loop: false` and the baseline_for call. a_check_still_failing_after_the_send_back_is_flagged_to_the_verifier asserts producer count 2, verifier count 1, the incomplete-report line and the verifier prompt carrying producer-report-gaps and the check name. Passes in cargo test -p athena-core.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs drives the real producer loop with a fake producer whose tree fails a configured check on the first pass and passes after the send-back. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`: it passes, and the brief of the second producer call contains the failed command and its output tail. On the base tree it fails because no send-back happens.
criteria_check.evidence: a_failing_check_is_sent_back_before_the_verifier_and_the_fix_reaches_it (tests.rs:4451) drives Athena::go with a fake producer that adds FIXED.txt only on `## Sent back`. It asserts Landed, producer count 2 and the second prompt carrying the command, `exit code 1` and the tail. Without the in-loop run there is one producer call and prompts[1] panics. cargo test -p athena-core passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A second test in crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs shows that when all checks pass on the first pass there is exactly one producer call and no send-back, and a test shows that a file added by the producer and listed only by `git ls-files` is seen by the in-loop check. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: all_checks_passing_means_one_producer_call_and_no_send_back (tests.rs:4569) asserts one producer call, no send-back and one in-loop marker line. a_file_the_producer_added_is_seen_by_the_in_loop_check (4602) shows the in-loop marker with new=yes and count 1. the_exposed_index_lists_new_files_and_is_restored_on_drop (4800) shows git ls-files lists the file only while the guard lives. All pass in cargo test -p athena-core.

criteria_check.criterion: The athena-cli tests that delete README.md and expect Rejected (retry.rs, introspection.rs, steward.rs, code_health_hooks.rs, lifecycle.rs:588) still pass with the extra producer pass. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran every athena-cli test target. lifecycle (79), introspection (35), steward (12), code_health_hooks (3), job_plan, mirrors, budgets, binary, auditor and the rest pass. One real break: retry.rs a_failed_check_retries_from_the_base indexed the retry's producer run as seen[1]; with the send-back the retry's run is seen[2]. I fixed it in retry.rs without weakening it: it now asserts three producer runs, that seen[1] holds `## Sent back`, and the same base-snapshot assertions on seen[2]; retry passes 28/28. drain.rs parallel::every_landing_path_ends_in_reinstall_for_any_unreadable_config failed once in the full run (a stub drain test that does not reach the producer loop) and passed alone, so I read it as a timing flake under load; I did not edit drain.rs.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md and the producer brief in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs tell the producer that Athena runs the configured checks before the verifier and sends a failure back once. A test in briefs.rs asserts that text. The producer.md edit is net-zero bytes and the prompt budgets in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs still pass.

Athena usually runs the checks before the verifier and sends a failure back once; run the suite at most once. `checks_run` lists only checks you ran.` Line 12 now reads: `Optional: if docs/agent-reference.md exists in the working copy, read it for the report; each rule is here and in your brief.` briefs.rs gains checks_before_verifier_section and the test producer_briefs_say_athena_runs_the_checks_before_the_verifier. cargo test -p athena-context passes (146) and the budgets test target passes (7).

open_issues: drain.rs parallel::every_landing_path_ends_in_reinstall_for_any_unreadable_config failed once under load in the full athena-cli run, with the stop Rebuilt where NeedsReinstall was expected. It passed when run alone. It uses stub steps and never reaches producer_loop, so I read it as a timing flake in the stubbed parallel drain, not an effect of this change. It was not reproduced a second time, and I did not edit drain.rs.

Departure from the literal wording of criterion 1, as the plan decided: GIT_INDEX_FILE is set only for the one `git add -A` that builds the temporary index. The index is then swapped into the snapshot's .git/index and restored on drop. It is not exported to the checks. This is recorded in D182 and the CHANGELOG bullet.
The wall-time cost and the busy-slot skip rate are estimates stated in D182, not measured.
mistakes: The first full athena-cli run was in the background, and I could not read its output. I had to rerun the suite in the foreground to see the failing tests.
learnings: The earlier attempt had already written almost all of the plan: checks.rs, producer.rs, send_back.rs, mod.rs, briefs.rs, producer.md, decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md and the tests. What remained was verification and one athena-cli assertion.
With the in-loop run, a rejected README-deleting job gets a second producer call. retry.rs a_failed_check_retries_from_the_base used seen[1] for the retry's run, which is now the send-back run.
The background task output lives under /tmp, outside the working directory, so it cannot be read from here; rerun in the foreground to see failures.
desires: Read access to the background task output file; I had to rerun the failing athena-cli suite in the foreground to see its failure.
